title: Bitcoin rockets above $64,000 as Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang, wiping out $372 million in shorts
summary: Bitcoin jumped more than 4% in an hour to $64,427 after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO on Monday. The sudden rally triggered $424 million in crypto market liquidations within an hour, according to CoinGlass, as traders betting on further declines were caught by the price reversal.
